selection: 11 fresh Highsmith items (two deliberately paired memorial views), 12 existing FSA/OWI color records, 9 photographic records from existing 100-record LOC snapshot. First 30 base; final 2 new independent increment files. Convenience sample, not random or representative.
acquisition_limit: LOC catalog API returned HTTP 429 after 11 successful records. Retained original responses and used already saved official item metadata for remaining records; image download endpoints succeeded. API search retry time excluded from detection.
metadata_note: Original metadata acquisition dates differ from image download dates. Per-record provenance is explicit.
rights_verification_note: FSA/OWI color collection rights statement independently rechecked 2026-11-14 through official LOC indexed rights page: public domain/free to use and reuse. For all other collections the per-item rights statement is retained. No blanket public-domain inference.
